skill_name: Write a summary of the following passage in 50 words or less.
workflow: The American alligator is a large reptile native to the Southeast United States. It can grow up to 11 feet in size, weighing up to 1,000 pounds, with its thick armor-like skin providing protection from predators. An ancient species, with fossil records showing it to be over 150 million years old, the alligator is one of the oldest living animals.
